payout_quote: Referring member can receive a $50 bonus for each friend (up to $1,000) once program requirements are met by the referred friend.
steps: Be a Travis Credit Union member (18+) with a Prime Share account and a TCU personal checking account
Log in to TCU digital banking to access your unique referral link; share it via social media or enter friends' email addresses
Friend registers using your link, qualifies for TCU membership, and opens a Prime Share account + eligible personal checking account (Access, Free, Investor, or Cheques Gratis)
Within the first 90 days of account opening, friend makes 12+ debit purchases of $10+ each OR direct deposits totaling $250+
You receive a $50 cash bonus in your TCU checking account within 60 days
catches: Cap: up to $1,000 in Refer-A-Friend bonuses per calendar year (20 x $50)
Friend must be new: no existing TCU personal checking, and none closed within the preceding 36 months
Qualifying direct deposits are payroll/personal income via ACH — debit/credit card credits, Zelle/Venmo, and external bank ACH transfers do not qualify
Membership setup costs the friend: one-time $5 membership fee + $5 minimum deposit in the Prime Share account
Reward reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT; both accounts must be open and in good standing when bonus is paid
US residents only; excludes TCU employees; trust accounts not eligible; offer may be discontinued at any time
biggest_catch: You can earn up to $1,000 a year — but your friend must do real work: 12 debit purchases of $10+ or $250 in payroll deposits within 90 days.
eligibility: Travis CU members 18+ with Prime Share + personal checking; referred friends must be new-to-TCU (no personal checking closed within 36 months)
timing: Friend qualifies within 90 days of account opening; bonus deposited within 60 days after qualification
